_comment: Tier-2 for skfem mixed_poisson#: pins the keyword-name set of skfem.condense and skfem.solve to the catalog's contract. condense must accept {A, b, x, I, D, expand}; solve must accept {A, b, x, I, solver}. Plus end-to-end smoke: get_dofs() returns DofsView (catalog claim), and condense(A, b, x=x, D=dofs) returns a >=3-tuple when x is supplied (catalog claim about extended return shape). Catalog generators rely on every one of these signature properties. Verified against skfem 12.0.1 on 2026-06-01. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable, INVERSE -- this fixture contains no pathology to remove: it is an API-drift gate, so the control proves the gate FIRES rather than that a fix works): T2_MUTATE=1 introspects a stand-in condense whose D= kwarg has been renamed Dirichlet=, i.e. exactly the skfem-13 rename the gate exists to catch; skfem.condense itself is still the one called later. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1: the unmutated run matches all 5 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 prints condense_missing_required=['D'], which removes 'condense_missing_required=[]' and fires the forbidden 'FAIL:', so the fixture goes red. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py
